label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is caused by the reset password email link using the default BASE_URL which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. The fix would be to ensure that the production environment correctly sets PUBLIC_URL or adjust how BASE_URL is determined in src/notifications/templates.ts.

text:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The reset password email links to localhost because the BASE_URL defaults to "http://localhost:3000" when the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. The issue likely stems from the production environment not setting this variable, causing the email to contain incorrect URLs.
